notes: Both occurrences of bədê are fused rather than split: the ASV spends only the one word *for* on the expression, so no morpheme has a rendering of its own and rule 30's one-rendering condition is met, exactly as with bəyad → *by* and mippənê → *because of*. The same chapter fuses mē-ʾên → *without* at 51.29 and 51.37 on the same footing.
The unit count falls from 32 to 30 because the two dê tokens now share their prepositions' units instead of standing as unrepresented units.
